name: Answer Campus
source:
A visual novel that takes you on a journey through a college campus to explore challenging scenarios around identity markers such as race, gender, sexuality, ableism, and more.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165790/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，带你踏上大学校园之旅，围绕种族、性别、性取向、体能歧视等身份标记探索具有挑战性的场景。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165790/]Steam[/url]]
